newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Electricidad leads Caracas bolsa to record close.
newsitem.headline: Electricidad leads Caracas bolsa to record close.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange rose across the board to a record close in strong trade as market optimism was boosted by a share dividend announcement by benchmark stock Electricidad de Caracas, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share index rose 2.35 percent to 9,716.46, as 34 stocks rose, five fell and six closed flat.
The bolsa, which Wednesday threw off the regional doldrums associated with the Brazilian market's vulnerability, was closed Thursday for a national holiday.
The announcement Thursday of a one-for-six share dividend by Electricidad had helped the bolsa surge on, brokers said.
"The announcement of the Electricidad dividend moved the market," said Bancaracas broker Ricardo Larrazabal.
Total trade was 17.125 billion bolivars ($34.6 million).

Electricidad shares closed up 15 bolivars at 830 bolivars. Another big winner was medium-size bank Banco Union, which jumped 701 bolivars to 2,200 bolivars. Brokers said interest in the stock picked up in recent days as two local groups battle for ownership.
Among other leading stocks, telephone company CANTV rose 34 bolivars to 3,149.00 bolivars and steel company Sivensa rose 17 bolivars to 285 bolivars.
Brokers said they saw no reason for the market not to continue rising to set new records next week based on the strong bullish sentiment at Friday's close.
